item.description: Natchitoches Police Department officers were dispatched to the 300 block of South Drive on Jan. 7 around 8:44 am in reference to vehicle crash. The initial investigation by the Natchitoches Police Department revealed that a 2025 Nissan Sentra was heading west on Woodyard Drive and failed to stop for the red light at South Drive. … Continue reading Natchitoches Police investigate crash on South Drive

item.title: Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office announces use of unmanned aerial systems (drones)
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office (NPSO) has begun employing small Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS), commonly referred to as drones, to assist in various law enforcement operations throughout Natchitoches Parish. The Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office cannot and will not use drones to “spy on” or invade the privacy of the citizens of Natchitoches Parish. item.description: Natchitoches Parish Coroner Steven M.
